title: Turn the repeated test-environment lesson into a deterministic check
description: Use the retrieved historical lesson as advice, verify current Git first, and implement a small standard-library-only test entry point: python -m milestone3.check. Only change milestone3/check.py and tests/test_check.py. --help and --print-command must work without jsonschema/PyYAML or credentials. --print-command emits one complete single-line uv run --offline --no-project --with jsonschema[format]==4.25.1 --with PyYAML==6.0.2 python -m unittest discover -s tests -q command. Default behavior checks installed distribution versions using importlib.metadata: jsonschema==4.25.1 and PyYAML==6.0.2; missing or mismatched dependencies return exit 2 with a short actionable message and that complete command, without running tests or installing anything. When versions match, delegate to this interpreter's python -m unittest discover -s tests -q using subprocess without a shell, propagate its exit code, and avoid recursive test invocation in regression tests. No network, new dependency, policy, memory, infrastructure, or credential changes. Observe RED before GREEN. Mention the memory ID/digest you used and actual pinned-environment test results in the handoff. Do not create agents, dispatch work, push, merge or self-approve. Independent tests, Reviewer, functional QA and final owner approval remain required. REVIEWER ADDITION: besides the Developer's two-file diff, independently review the controller-supplied milestone3 memory foundation and tests against baseline 1c41e40d47337b5418b87ed70c7292694c61a272. Prior review found four now-regression-tested bugs (hidden dirty Git bytes, self-supersession, completed-edge replay, malformed responses); scoped Codex re-review was quota-blocked, not passed. Review milestone3/memory.py, cli.py, live_probe.py, fixtures/check-stage.mjs, lesson fixture, and tests/test_memory*.py for remaining Important/Critical defects. Supervised preparation only; no unattended runtime-freshness or performance-improvement claim. Do not approve unless both foundation and promotion are sound.
